all_found.desc: [ADVISORY] The released()/repoHooksID doc comments say a dir becomes free because an uninstall took the scripts out and that uninstall+reinstall reuses it that way, but uninstall no longer removes scripts from a user-level dir (reuse comes from the recorded metareview.hooksId). A maintainer may reintroduce emptying on uninstall, the bug fixed in d368145.

findings.issue_text: [ADVISORY] The Stale status returns Installed:false for an earlier (e.g. pre-#173 checkout-local) location whose gate scripts are still in place and still block pushes, so enforcementStatus appends 'The git-native pre-push gate is not installed either, so nothing stops a host...'. Every upgraded pre-#173 user reading setup --check before migrating is told pushes are ungated when they are still gated.
